caption: This shio ramen boasts a clear, golden broth, topped with halved soft-boiled egg, nori, and chashu pork, arranged neatly in a white ceramic bowl. Warm, ambient lighting highlights the dish against a wooden table, with a spoon resting beside it.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain pattern with smooth texture and subtle natural wood texture details.
Chashu pork slice shows pinkish-brown meat with visible fat marbling, glossy surface, and green herb flecks.
Nori seaweed appears dark green, slightly crinkled, with a rough, uneven surface and irregular, fragmented shape.
The shio (salt) broth is golden-yellow, clear, and glossy, holding thin noodles, bean sprouts, and garnishes in a smooth, reflective surface.
A halved boiled egg shows a runny orange yolk, translucent white, and a small shrimp inside, with green herbs on its surface.
Cream-colored ceramic ramen bowl with subtle black pattern and smooth, slightly glossy rim.
